fixtures.name: exprfix
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT i AS id, (CASE WHEN i % 13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE i % 50 END)::INTEGER AS a, (CASE WHEN i % 17 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i * 7) % 60 END)::BIGINT AS b, ((i % 97) * 0.5)::DOUBLE AS x, ((i % 1000) * 0.01)::DECIMAL(12, 2) AS p, ((i % 37) * 0.1)::DECIMAL(9, 1) AS q, (CASE WHEN i % 19 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'k' || (i % 23) END) AS s, 'k' || (i % 29) AS t, (DATE '1995-01-01' + (i % 400)::INTEGER) AS d1, (DATE '1995-01-01' + (i % 333)::INTEGER) AS d2, (TIMESTAMP '1995-01-01' + to_seconds(i)) AS ts, (i % 5)::BIGINT AS z FROM range(0, 20000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 4096)

fixtures.name: deccmp
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT i AS id, (i % 50)::BIGINT AS k, (CASE WHEN i % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i % 41) - 20) * 0.5 END)::DECIMAL(7, 2) AS a72, (CASE WHEN i % 13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i * 7919) % 20001 - 10000) / 100.0 END)::DECIMAL(7, 2) AS a72h, (CASE WHEN i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i % 37) - 18) * 0.5 END)::DECIMAL(5, 2) AS b52, (CASE WHEN i % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i % 23) - 11) * 0.25 END)::DECIMAL(9, 4) AS c94, (CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i % 15) - 7 END)::DECIMAL(9, 0) AS z90, (CASE WHEN i % 17 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i % 29) - 14) * 0.5 END)::DECIMAL(18, 6) AS d186, (CASE WHEN i % 19 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i % 31) - 15) * 0.5 END)::DECIMAL(18, 4) AS e184, (CASE WHEN i % 3 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i % 31) - 15) * 0.5 END)::DECIMAL(38, 10) AS f3810, (CASE WHEN i % 4 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i % 13) - 6) * 0.5 END)::DECIMAL(38, 19) AS g3819, (CASE WHEN i % 6 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i % 17) - 8) * 0.5 END)::DECIMAL(38, 18) AS h3818 FROM range(0, 3000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 512)
